pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which colour is best for a road safety bib? (1 mark)
   A. Grey
   B. Bright orange or yellow
   C. Dark brown
   D. Black

2. What is a factory? (1 mark)
   A. A hospital
   B. A market
   C. A school
   D. A large building where goods are made with machines

3. How many MCAs does each ward elect? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. None
   C. One
   D. Fifty

4. On a dot map where one dot means 500 people, an area has 4 dots. How many people live there? (1 mark)
   A. 20,000
   B. 400
   C. 4,500
   D. 2,000

5. What does listening do for peace? (1 mark)
   A. It wastes time
   B. It helps people to understand each other
   C. It makes people angry
   D. It starts fights

6. What is barter? (1 mark)
   A. Giving things away
   B. Exchanging one thing for another without money
   C. Stealing
   D. Buying with money only

7. Thimlich Ohinga is found in which county? (1 mark)
   A. Turkana
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Migori

8. Which of these is an honest practice in business? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating customers
   B. Hiding sales money
   C. Giving correct change
   D. Selling bad goods as good

9. What is a right? (1 mark)
   A. A punishment
   B. A chore
   C. A game
   D. Something every person is allowed to have or do

10. What should you do when visiting a factory? (1 mark)
   A. Stay with the group and not touch machines
   B. Run around
   C. Shout
   D. Touch all machines

11. Which minister would deal with dirty toilets? (1 mark)
   A. Sports
   B. Health and sanitation
   C. Music
   D. Library

12. What is a conflict? (1 mark)
   A. A holiday
   B. A song
   C. A disagreement or quarrel
   D. A book

13. What is a kiondo? (1 mark)
   A. A basket
   B. A shirt
   C. A drum
   D. A house

14. Keeping cattle, goats and camels in dry areas is called what? (1 mark)
   A. Fishing
   B. Mining
   C. Trading
   D. Pastoralism

15. Which words help to tell a history in order? (1 mark)
   A. Big, small, tall
   B. Up, down, left
   C. Red, blue, green
   D. First, then, later, today

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why forgiveness is important for peace. (3 marks)

17. State two things a good map key should show. (2 marks)

18. State three duties of a village elder. (3 marks)

19. Explain what interdependence means and give one example. (3 marks)

20. Give two ways in which Mount Kenya is useful. (2 marks)

21. Name two places where you can find information about your school's history. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Bright orange or yellow
   Bright colours are easy to see.

2. D — A large building where goods are made with machines
   Factories use machines to make goods.

3. C — One
   Each ward elects one MCA.

4. D — 2,000
   4 x 500 = 2,000.

5. B — It helps people to understand each other
   Listening helps solve conflicts.

6. B — Exchanging one thing for another without money
   Barter means swapping goods, such as a goat for grain.

7. D — Migori
   Thimlich Ohinga is in Migori County.

8. C — Giving correct change
   Honesty is right in business.

9. D — Something every person is allowed to have or do
   Rights protect people.

10. A — Stay with the group and not touch machines
   Safety rules protect visitors.

11. B — Health and sanitation
   Health and sanitation looks after cleanliness.

12. C — A disagreement or quarrel
   A conflict is a disagreement.

13. A — A basket
   The kiondo is a woven basket.

14. D — Pastoralism
   Pastoralism is keeping livestock on natural pasture.

15. D — First, then, later, today
   Time words link events in order.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: It ends quarrels, it helps friendships to grow again, and it stops anger from continuing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: The meaning of the colours and the meaning of the lines or symbols used on the map.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct item.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Welcome visitors, settle small quarrels and call meetings. Accept reporting problems.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each duty.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Interdependence means people depend on and help each other. For example, a farmer grows food and a trader sells it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for showing both sides need each other.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: It gives water for rivers and it attracts tourists. Accept rich soils for farming.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct use.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The headteacher or teachers, and the school records or log book. Accept old photographs or elders.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each source.
